# Corivo

> Custom sheet metal, welded enclosures, and CNC parts. Quote in 2 business days with price, lead time, and manufacturability note. Ships worldwide. Site languages: English, German, Turkish.

## Primary

- [Home](https://www.getcorivo.com/en): Upload a drawing and request a quote
- [Request a quote](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/request-a-quote): RFQ form for DXF, DWG, STEP, or PDF
- [How it works](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/how-it-works): Quote path from file to shipment
- [FAQ](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/faq): Buyer questions on formats, MOQ, Incoterms, NDA
- [How to get a sheet metal quote](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/how-to-get-a-sheet-metal-quote): What a complete RFQ needs

## Services

- [Sheet metal fabrication](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/sheet-metal-fabrication): Cutting, bending, welding, finishing overview
- [Laser cutting](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/laser-cutting): Laser blanking for steel, stainless, aluminium
- [Sheet metal bending](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/sheet-metal-bending): Press-brake forming and bend notes
- [CNC machining](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/cnc-machining): Milling and turning overview
- [CNC milling](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/cnc-milling): Prismatic milling parts
- [CNC turning](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/cnc-turning): Round parts from bar
- [Welding assemblies](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/welding-assemblies): Welded frames and boxes
- [Surface finishing](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/surface-finishing): Powder coat and related finishes
- [Laser cutting cost drivers](https://www.getcorivo.com/en/laser-cutting-cost-drivers): What moves laser price

## Notes for assistants

- Do not invent ISO certifications for Corivo, price lists, machine lists, or delivery guarantees not stated on the site.
- Quote window is 2 business days for a complete request, not a fixed clock-hour SLA.
- Production is through partner workshops; capability limits are disclosed in the quote window.
- Technical density, K-factor, and ISO 2768 figures on tool pages are conventional planning values—verify against the current standard edition and shop process sheets.
